item.title: Iran's soccer team cannot participate in the FIFA World Cup, Iranian minister says
item.summary: Iran is set to play three games in the U.S. this June. But amid the U.S.-Israel military campaign that has killed Iran's supreme leader, Iran's sports minister said the team would pull out.

item.title: Pentagon probe points to U.S. missile hitting Iranian school
item.summary: A military assessment suggests a U.S. Tomahawk cruise missile was responsible for at least 165 deaths at an Iranian girls' school, according to a U.S. official who was not authorized to speak publicly.

item.title: How the Iran war is disrupting air travel -- and advice if you're planning a trip
item.summary: The war in Iran is roiling jet fuel prices and airlines are beginning to hike prices, unsettling travelers far from the Middle East. If you're booking a flight soon, here are things to know.

item.title: Epstein's longtime accountant testifies he was 'not aware' of sex offender's crimes
item.summary: Richard Kahn testified to the House Oversight Committee that he did not know about Epstein's crimes. He said monetary gifts that Epstein made did not raise any red flags.

item.title: Harrison Ford isn't retiring: 'I really wouldn't know what to do with myself'
item.summary: Ford struggled to find his footing in Hollywood before being cast as Han Solo in Star Wars. Now 83, he plays a therapist in the Apple TV series Shrinking: "I really do love the work," he says.

item.title: Rebecca Gayheart Dane on caring for her late husband, Eric Dane, and synthetic voices
item.summary: The wife of 'Grey's Anatomy' actor Eric Dane says caring for him gave her an "extra dose" of compassion for others.

item.title: No Nobles Day: Britain's Parliament boots its last hereditary Lords after 700 years
item.summary: Government minister Nick Thomas-Symonds said the change put an end to "an archaic and undemocratic principle." The removed aristocrats are 92 of the House of Lords' 800 members.

item.title: On her new album, Kacey Musgraves returns home, to the 'Middle of Nowhere'
item.summary: Before making her upcoming sixth album, the country star returned to her small-town Texas home and discovered the power of in-between spaces. "I found a lot of clarity there," she says.

item.title: The government is investigating new claims that DOGE misused Social Security data
item.summary: The fallout from DOGE staffers' efforts to access sensitive Social Security data continues as an agency watchdog disclosed a new investigation into "potential misuse" reported by a whistleblower.

item.title: Chile turns right: Kast inaugurated as nation's most conservative leader since Pinochet
item.summary: Chile has sworn in its most right-wing president in decades — and his rise, and ideology, are rooted in a small town beneath the Andes.
